create_visualizer: create a Visualizer instance with an opt object and optional name for TensorBoard logging
log_images: log a dictionary of labeled images to the TensorBoard logger at a given step
log_scalars: log a dictionary of scalar labels and values to the TensorBoard logger at a given step
print_current_scalars: print and write epoch, iteration, and scalar values to the console and log file
review_Visualizer_class: review the Visualizer class and its methods for TensorBoard image and scalar logging
